description: A small plastic container separated by a seal.  One side holds calcium carbide powder, the other holds a small amount of water.  Breaking the seal causes an immediate chemical reaction that produces acetylene gas, which will eventually rupture the container with a loud bang.

use_action.msg: You break the seal, mixing the calcium carbide with water.  The pressure builds rapidly…

description: Acetylene gas is building up inside this container, and it's about to burst.  You should throw it immediately!

use_action.message: The seal is already broken on this calcium carbide popper.  Throw it, quickly!
use_action.name: Break seal

tick_action.sound_message: A hissing fizz comes from the carbide popper.
